source: Reference answers from Claude Opus 5.5 (medium effort), answered blind. Each case was given exactly the system prompt, user message and output schema the gateway sends to a Messages API upstream (captured from the gateway at 75eed5c), then mapped back through the gateway itself (normalization, choice, score, confidence, 2-decimal rounding). The without_user_instructions answers come from a separate agent that never saw the user_instructions variant.

reasons.handling_mode: Objective is classification, which matches giving the incident a type label.
reasons.user_impact: Internal wiki down for all users is noticeable but usually not work-stopping.
reasons.wiki_unavailable: Monitoring shows HTTP 503 for every user.

reasons.handling_mode: The referenced user-instruction objective is absent, so no output kind is favored; near-uniform.
reasons.user_impact: Wiki down for all users but other services work; disruption likely noticeable, severity depends on wiki reliance.
reasons.wiki_unavailable: Monitoring shows HTTP 503 for every user at 09:12.

ui_dependence: The objective field in user_instructions is the only thing that tells the model which kind of output is wanted; without it the three options are equally plausible.
